title: FunnyMOTD
description: FunnyMOTD is a lightweight and powerful plugin that allows you to fully control what players see when they log into your server.
body:
**FunnyMOTD: Relive your server's greeting!**

**_Tired of the boring, standard greeting? FunnyMOTD is a lightweight and powerful plugin that allows you to fully control what players see when they log into your server. Make your welcome message (MOTD) unique, dynamic and engaging to make an immediate impression!_**

**What does this project add?**

FunnyMOTD provides a flexible system for setting up a two-line welcome message. It replaces the standard Minecraft MOTD with fully customizable text that you can change at any time.

**Key Features and functions:**

**Dynamic MOTD**: Set up a list of messages in the config.yml file, and the plugin will randomly select one of the lines each time the server is pinged. This makes your greeting lively and unpredictable.

**Static MOTD:** Would you prefer to have an important announcement always in plain sight? Just turn on static mode and your MOTD will stay the same.

**Two-line design:** Use both MOTD lines to convey all the necessary information. For example, show the creative phrase in the first line and the number of players in the second.

**Customizable Messages:** Full support for Minecraft color codes (&) allows you to create vivid and memorable messages.

**Automatic update of the player counter**: The plugin automatically displays the current number of online players, which is very convenient for monitoring the server.

**Why should I download FunnyMOTD?**

_The FunnyMOTD project is designed to help you make your server visible._

**Make a first impression:** A vibrant and dynamic MOTD can attract the attention of players who browse the server list.

**Simplicity and flexibility:** All settings are in one simple config.yml file. You can change the messages in a matter of seconds.

**Keep players informed:** Use MOTD to announce events, updates, or just to maintain a friendly atmosphere.

**Make your server memorable by installing FunnyMOTD today!**
